messages.subject: R1035 fixture audit complete
messages.body: I verified all snapshot manifest hashes and audited the fixture/proposal against the supplied QSA prototype contract without running builds or tests. I found one low-severity coverage gap: per-row unused head-scratch canaries are not checked although the output says scratch guards pass; the report gives the exact lines and smallest correction, and found the numerical, dead-key, top-k, status, and lifetime gates source-sane. Remaining limits are runtime/provider/lowering and model-quality evidence, which this source-only fixture cannot establish.
